wins: Maintained consistent reconnaissance pacing that yielded all required host data within the episode, achieving the full 70-point reward despite failing to complete final objective.
Documented every mentor call lesson, enabling rapid hypothesis adjustments in subsequent exploratory scans.
fails: Agent failed to transition from information gathering to exploitation, leading to 0% success rate despite exhaustive probing.
Repeatedly restarted enumeration after each failed attempt rather than building on partial insights, causing redundant actions and resource waste.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance execution but inability to operationalize gathered intelligence into exploitation; focus next on workflow handoff from scan to action.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failure to launch exploitation after confirming open service ports, resulting in repeated mentor calls without progress.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts to gather version and configuration data

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with 200 OK on port 80 after initial scan
skill_cards.then_action: Launch directory fuzzing with ffuf and record discovered endpoints for follow-up

skill_cards.if_condition: After each enumeration cycle when new services discovered
skill_cards.then_action: Append service details to centralized notes and add potential exploits for quick recall

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase

next_experiments.title: Integrate service-specific exploit hypotheses
next_experiments.description: Develop a systematic transition after enumeration that selects and attempts at least one tailored exploit per confirmed service before looping back.

next_experiments.title: Chain mentor feedback into actionable checklists
next_experiments.description: After each mentor call, auto-generate a checklist of suggested actions and verify execution before moving forward.
